text: Provides a platform for vendors to design triggers/actions, wire authentication, and publish an integration to the Zapier App Directory
quote: Build a Zapier integration - design triggers and actions for your product, wire up authentication, then publish to the App Directory.

text: Gives coding agents programmatic, token-free access to 9,000+ apps by handling OAuth and credential complexity
quote: Give coding agents programmatic access to 9,000+ apps: Zapier handles OAuth, credentials, and API complexity so you never touch a token.

text: Platform CLI lets developers build integrations with Node.js, OAuth1/2, webhooks, polling triggers, and HTTP middleware
quote: Zapier Platform CLI enables developers to build integrations using Node.js v22, OAuth1/OAuth2 authentication, webhooks, polling triggers, and HTTP middleware.

text: Agent skills built on Zapier can be discovered on npm/skill registries and run as an agent skill, CLI, typed Node module, or local MCP server
quote: Agents discover them on npm and skill registries, then run them as an agent skill, a CLI, a typed Node module, or a local MCP server.

text: Automation capabilities can be embedded directly into another product so end users connect apps and run automations under that product's own brand
quote: Embed Zapier's automation capabilities directly into your product so users can connect apps and run automations under your brand.

text: AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor can connect to Gmail, Slack, Salesforce, and 9,000+ apps with no code required
quote: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other AI tools to Gmail, Slack, Salesforce, and 9,000+ apps. No code. No setup headaches.

text: A single natural-language prompt can have an AI find availability and book a meeting across calendars
quote: Schedule a meeting with one prompt. Your AI finds time on everyone's calendar and books it. No back and forth.

text: Users can create specialized AI agents, assisted by Zapier Copilot, that connect to business data and perform tasks across 9,000+ apps
quote: Create specialized agents—with the help of Zapier Copilot—to connect to your business data and perform tasks across 9,000+ apps.

text: Visual mapping tool (Canvas) lets teams add owners, notes, and images to build structured, documented process diagrams
quote: Simplify and scale your processes with visual mapping—add owners, notes, and images to create structured, easy-to-follow systems.

text: Zapier uses AI to generate troubleshooting instructions for users to review
quote: Zapier will use AI to create troubleshooting instructions for you to review.

text: Any MCP-compatible AI client can get one governed, SOC 2-certified connection to 9,000+ apps with no code or infrastructure required
quote: Give any MCP-compatible AI client governed access to 9,000+ apps through one connection: no code, no infrastructure, SOC 2 certified.

text: Existing app connections/credentials set up in a Zapier account are automatically reused rather than requiring re-authentication
quote: Zapier brings in your existing app connections automatically. Gmail, Slack, Salesforce, whatever you've already set up in Zapier is ready to go.

text: IT can manage one governed MCP connection with account-level restrictions and workspace controls that apply across every AI agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor)
quote: Zapier MCP gives IT one governed connection across every AI agent your org uses: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor. Account-level restrictions, managed connections, and workspace controls apply to all of them.

text: Canvas automatically maps and optimizes business processes to help teams document, refine, and automate them
quote: Canvas automatically maps and optimizes your processes to help your team document, refine, and automate with ease.

text: Users can build workflows either with a no-code Visual Builder for quick setups or with the CLI for full developer control
quote: Use the Visual Builder for quick, no-code setups or the CLI for full control and customization.

text: Users can describe a task in plain language and the AI calls the correct Zapier action and confirms what it did
quote: Describe what you need in plain language. Your AI calls the right Zapier action and confirms what it did.

text: The Visual Builder enables quick deployment and cross-team collaboration on automations without developer expertise
quote: the Visual Builder is the place to start. It’s ideal for quick deployment and collaboration across teams, even without developer expertise.

text: A Workflow API combined with 9,000+ integrations can power a custom built-in automation experience, integration marketplace, or AI workflows
quote: Use Zapier's Workflow API and 9,000 integrations to power a built-in automation experience, integration marketplace, or AI workflows.

text: AI agents can take real actions like sending messages, creating tasks, and updating records across 9,000+ apps and 40,000+ actions
quote: It lets your AI take real actions across 9,000+ apps and 40,000+ actions, such as sending messages, creating tasks, and updating records
